data.title: Mijime na Kiseki
data.synopsis:
Inspired by Henri Michaux's book of poetry and drawings of the same name. Masterful in both vision and execution, the film explores the limits of language and perception, creating dazzling connections between sound, meaning, shapes and movement. Propelling viewers beyond the page, guided by Tony Robinow's feverish voiceover, the poems map the human psyche to the very edges of alienation and transcendence.

(Source: NFB)

data.title_english: Ever-Changing Clouds, Like My Ever-Changing Life
data.synopsis:
In a city like an abyss, the four children who have just graduated from school grow up in the journey and embark on their own lives in the journey. They are separated and reunited. Perhaps the reunion is joy, while the separation has become numb, they drift with the tide and fight against time.

(Source: Official Site)
